{{Portal|Latter Day Saints}}
The '''Latter Day Saint movement''' is a group of religious denominations and adherents who follow at least some of the [[Teachings of Joseph Smith Jr.|teachings and revelations]] of [[Joseph Smith Jr.]], publisher of the [[Book of Mormon]] in 1830. The Latter Day Saint movement is one of a number of separate movements that arose during the [[Second Great Awakening]] of the 19th century, many of which were strongly [[Restorationism (Christian primitivism)|restorationist]] in outlook, seeking to transcend [[Protestant]] [[denominationalism]] and to restore a form of [[Christianity]] thought to be more consistent with the [[New Testament]].
